name: Urban floods – Bellandur and Mahadevapura, Bengaluru
region: Bellandur, Mahadevapura and Varthur, Bengaluru Urban district
description: Hypothetical urban flood in the pattern of September 2022, when Bellandur and Varthur lakes overflowed into the IT corridor. Inundation is simulated from distance to the real lakes and storm-water drains (decay 0.9 km).
data_note: Roads, facilities and population are real (OpenStreetMap, WorldPop or OSM building counts). Damage severity, accessibility, vulnerability and relief stock are SIMULATED for the demo and do not describe a real event; every zone carries source="simulated".

sources.population: WorldPop 2020 (1 km, constrained to zone area)
